root_cause.text: The netfilter x_tables get-entries code in IPv4/IPv6/ARP copied the full kernel rule entry struct, including the internal `counters.pcnt` per-CPU pointer, to userspace before replacing it with sanitized counters, so a `copy_to_user` fault could expose the raw kernel pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `copy_to_user(..., e, sizeof(*e))` / `sizeof(struct ipt_entry|ip6t_entry|arpt_entry)` to copy only up to `offsetof(..., counters)` and then separately copy `&counters[num]`, while the CVE/commit explicitly states that `entry->counters.pcnt` contains the percpu allocation address and could be leaked if the initial header copy faulted before the sanitized counter overwrite.
